summary: Trustmark Corp's bank subsidiary sold 34 branch properties in MS, FL, TN, AL and TX to Blue Owl Real Estate Capital affiliates for $91.7 million, simultaneously signing 15-year triple-net leases with three five-year renewal options at initial aggregate annual rent of $6.4 million, escalating 1.5% annually. No branches close and no markets exit. The sale-leaseback produced a roughly $61.5 million pre-tax gain, offset by a $61.5 million pre-tax loss from reclassifying held-to-maturity securities and swapping $629.9 million of 1.4%-yield securities into $628.0 million of 5.0%-yield securities. Watch capital, NII and rate-risk effects, not deal-arb.
